tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Detect COCO objects (person, car, truck, bus, motorcycle, bicycle, ...). Cheap. Usually the first step.

tools.name: read_plate
tools.description: Find and read vehicle license plates. Run only when a vehicle was found.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Read general text (signs, labels, containers). Slow on CPU; prefer conditional use.

tools.name: detect_faces
tools.description: Detect faces (no identity). Run only when a person was found.

tools.name: identify_faces
tools.description: Detect faces and match them against enrolled persons. Run only when a person was found.
